pages.title: What It Gives
pages.text:
Lethality at range that no medieval gear matches.

It denies you independence. You cannot make a gun.

pages.title: Your First Hour
pages.text:
1. Go down. Dungeon chests are where the old weapons are.
2. Mine GUNPOWDER ORE below minus sixty-four. Nowhere else has it.
3. Build a GUN SMITH TABLE and hand-load cartridges.
4. The weapon you found decides which ammunition you need. Not the other way round.
